description: MDN_PARSE_MAX_BLOB_IDS = 16 is a private constant in the library (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mdn.rs). Consumers have no way to override this limit without forking the crate. The spec (draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17 §3.3) does not mandate any limit — it says 'a server-defined rate limit.' The 16 was chosen as a conservative default with a rationale comment, but hard-coding it in library code means it will generate user complaints ('why can I only parse 16 MDNs per request?') with no escape hatch. Fix: add max_blob_ids: usize parameter to handle_mdn_parse, or expose the constant as pub so consumers can at least read it. A parameter is better — it matches the max_calls pattern in parse_request.
title: MDN_PARSE_MAX_BLOB_IDS hardcoded in library — consumers cannot configure
